title: Jupyter Notebooks
motto: Notebooks are the lab bench of AI engineering. You prototype here, then move what works into production.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Notebooks are the lab bench of AI engineering. You prototype here, then move what works into production.

steps.title: The problem
cards: Every AI paper, tutorial, and Kaggle competition uses Jupyter notebooks. They let you run code in pieces, see outputs inline, mix code with explanations, and iterate fast. If you try to learn AI without notebooks, you're doing math homework without scratch paper.

But notebooks have real traps. People use them for everything, including things they're terrible at. Knowing when to use a notebook and when to use a script will save you from debugging nightmares later.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: A notebook is a list of cells. Each cell is either code or text.
